note: The original described the soldier taken from the same dead vine as a separate species, Kalotermes (Cryptotermes?) cubicoceps, rather than assigning it to this species, so this entry has no soldier section; Emerson also noted that the two may be conspecific.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate: head yellow-brown, broadly oval; antennae 13-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 equal in length; compound eyes medium-sized, their lower edge about 3/4 of the eye diameter from the lower margin of the head; ocelli small, touching the compound eyes. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, the posterior margin nearly straight. Wings transparent; the subcosta meeting the anterior wing margin at about 1/4 of the wing length from the wing base; the radius unbranched except near the wing apex; the media fused with the radius for a stretch (about 1/7 of the wing length) in the forewing on at least one side, then parallel to it; femora slightly swollen, with arolia.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head yellow-brown, broadly oval, with a few hairs. Antennae 13-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 equal in length. Compound eyes medium-sized, about 3/4 of their diameter from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli small, touching the compound eyes. Pronotum yellow-brown, with a few hairs, slightly narrower than the head, the sides depressed and rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight. Femora slightly swollen, with arolia. Wings transparent; the subcosta joining the anterior margin at about 1/4 of the wing length from the wing base; the radius parallel to the anterior margin, unbranched except near the apex; the media usually fused with the radius for about 1/7 of the wing length in the forewing on at least one side, thereafter parallel to the radius to the wing apex; subcosta, radius and media distinct, the cubitus indistinct, with about 13 branches. Abdominal tergites yellow-brown, with a few hairs. Measurements: body length with wings 7.00—8.00 mm, body length without wings 4.41—4.70 mm; head length 1.06—1.12 mm, head width 0.88—0.94 mm; antennal length 1.00—1.05 mm; compound eye diameter 0.27—0.29 mm; pronotal length 0.52—0.53 mm, width 0.82—0.85 mm; forewing length 5.76—5.88 mm, width 1.59—1.63 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality Kartabo, British Guiana, known only from the type locality. The holotype is an alate. The description is based on 8 alates and 2 dealated specimens: the alates were all taken singly while flying to light; the dealated specimens were taken together with several nymphs from a piece of dead vine, and from the same piece of dead vine a single soldier of Kalotermes (Cryptotermes?) cubicoceps was collected separately, the two never being taken together. Because that soldier is morphologically close to Cryptotermes while the alate of this species agrees with Glyptotermes, Emerson treated them as two species and noted that they might be the same species.
